profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Whatnot | ex-Airbnb
profile.summary:
I’m a seasoned software engineer with 10+ years of experience building high-consequence systems where correctness, safety, and reliability directly impact real users and businesses.
 
Over the past several years at Airbnb, I’ve worked on trust & safety, authorization, and compliance systems. Areas where small gaps can lead to meaningful financial loss, policy violations, or degraded user trust. My work has included designing real-time decisioning systems, building scalable data platforms, and developing enforcement mechanisms that operate reliably at scale.
 
One example is a user segmentation platform I led, which replaced fragmented allowlists with a centralized, auditable system for defining and applying user-level decisions. The system balanced real-time and batch processing, prioritized fail-safe behavior, and became a shared platform adopted by multiple teams.
 
I’m particularly interested in problems at the intersection of distributed systems, risk, and infrastructure, especially where systems must operate under ambiguity, adversarial conditions, and strict correctness requirements.
 
Recently, I’ve been exploring how these patterns extend into AI systems, including real-time safeguards, policy enforcement, and monitoring in LLM-powered applications.
 
I’m excited to continue building systems that are not only scalable, but also safe, explainable, and resilient in the face of real-world complexity.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led a project to launch payment/subscription service. Integrated Stripe API and TaxJar API and also dealt with recurring updates such as subscription renewal process by creating webhook endpoint/handler which listen to the events triggered from Stripe written in Golang
- Streamlined ad creation flow by integrating Facebook Graph/Marketing API and Google Adwords API
- Set up file upload status alert system with AWS S3, AWS SQS, and web socket from backend to front-end
- Visualised the map using Leaflet to render the dynamic data based on the location where user drops the pin
- Created RESTful API backend with Golang to get various data from demographics to transportation based on the location
- Produced autocomplete search service with back-end by using Mapzen API to provide expected location list before user type the whole address
- Utilized many libraries/tools such as Reactjs, Redux, Webpack, React-router, Redux-saga, and more to build fast and reusable components for the front-end UI with dynamic data and resourceful rendering assets
